def mine_line(xd, ys, face, ore):
    res = []
    for y in ys:
        p = Position(x=xd, y=y)
        move_to(p)
        d = place_entity(Prototype.ElectricMiningDrill, position=p, direction=face)
        f = place_entity_next_to(Prototype.StoneFurnace, d.position, direction=face, spacing=0)
        f = insert_item(Prototype.Coal, f, 50)
        i = place_entity_next_to(Prototype.Inserter, f.position, direction=face, spacing=0)
        res.append((d, f, i))
        print(ore, 'drill', d.position, 'drop', d.drop_position, 'furn', f.position, 'ins', i.position, i.pickup_position, i.drop_position)
    return res
